matters.title: Oklahoma poultry-litter litigation & settlement (Illinois River watershed)
matters.status: Federal-court judgment entered Dec. 2025 (stayed on appeal Aug. 18, 2026); $42M settlement signed July 10, 2026, awaiting vacatur and dismissal
matters.summary: Oklahoma sued poultry companies over decades of poultry-litter application in the Illinois River watershed. A December 2025 judgment against the companies has been stayed while the courts decide whether to release it so a signed settlement — payments, a seven-year step-down of litter application, and an independent compliance monitor — can take effect.

matters.title: United States v. Ganaderos Borges, Inc. (Naguabo, PR slaughterhouse)
matters.status: Criminal Clean Water Act indictment (Aug. 2026); not-guilty plea; plant operating under court-ordered environmental-compliance conditions
matters.summary: A federal grand jury indicted the slaughterhouse, its president, and employees, alleging years of concealed discharges of untreated slaughter waste into a creek reaching the Caribbean Sea. An indictment contains allegations only; all defendants are presumed innocent unless convicted.

matters.title: Pacific Seafood Clean Water Act citizen suits (Warrenton, OR & Quilcene, WA)
matters.status: Three federal citizen suits filed Jan.–Aug. 2026; no adjudication
matters.summary: Environmental groups allege thousands of Clean Water Act permit violations at Pacific Seafood's Warrenton, Oregon rendering plant and NPDES temperature-limit violations at its Quilcene, Washington shellfish hatchery. These are the plaintiffs' allegations; no court has adjudicated any violation.

matters.title: JBS Greeley, CO beef plant air permit (CBD v. Colorado APCD)
matters.classification: Permit dispute / litigation pending — allegations only
matters.status: State suit filed Apr. 7, 2026 over a four-year-pending Clean Air Act operating permit; 60-day federal notice served on JBS
matters.summary: The Center for Biological Diversity alleges Colorado regulators let the JBS Greeley slaughterhouse operate for years without a required air-pollution operating permit while emitting particulates, ammonia, and other pollutants. This matter concerns the Greeley, Colorado plant (EST. 969). These are the plaintiff's allegations; no court has adjudicated any violation.
